title: PowerShell for Fleets: Objects, Not Text

scenes.say: Why do big Windows shops demand PowerShell? It's all about objects, not text.

scenes.label: Objects
scenes.sub: Filter with Where-Object, pick with Select-Object, export with Export-Csv.
scenes.say: PowerShell passes objects. That means you filter with Where-Object, pick with Select-Object, and export with Export-Csv—no messy text parsing.
Here's a real example: check HTTPS on all servers, output as objects, and export to CSV in one go.

scenes.title: Invoke-Command
scenes.say: Need to run commands on many servers at once? Use Invoke-Command with WinRM for parallel remote control.

scenes.question: Which is preferred in PowerShell 7?
scenes.say: Watch out: Get-WmiObject is gone in PowerShell seven. Use Get-CimInstance instead.
